claims.text: The datasets used for evaluation are CSAT, 20 newsgroups, and Fisher.
The CSAT dataset is used for customer satisfaction prediction, while 20 newsgroups and Fisher are used for topic identification tasks.
The 20 newsgroups dataset contains approximately 20,000 documents across 20 topics.
The Fisher dataset is used for classification tasks and is noted for its performance in the study.
